plan.policy: Crossing: every seat walks +z. Rescue: middle seat rests for 60 ticks then walks -z; others hold brace. All declared ticks run, even if terminal.
plan.delivery: Simulation state is real; synthetic all-connected Climber labels and ackSeq=2*tick mirror BelayRoom seat decoration. No sockets, joins or transport latency measured.
